evidence.query: WITH fy2025_rev AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, dc.parent_customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS customer_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc ON fi.customer_id = dc.customer_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fil.service_period_start AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY fi.customer_id, dc.parent_customer_id), group_rev AS (SELECT COALESCE(parent_customer_id, customer_id) AS economic_group_id, SUM(customer_revenue) AS group_revenue FROM fy2025_rev GROUP BY COALESCE(parent_customer_id, customer_id)), total AS (SELECT SUM(group_revenue) AS total_rev FROM group_rev), ranked AS (SELECT economic_group_id, group_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY group_revenue DESC) AS rev_rank FROM group_rev) SELECT t.total_rev, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rev_rank <= 1 THEN r.group_revenue ELSE 0 END)/t.total_rev*100 AS top1_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rev_rank <= 3 THEN r.group_revenue ELSE 0 END)/t.total_rev*100 AS top3_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rev_rank <= 5 THEN r.group_revenue ELSE 0 END)/t.total_rev*100 AS top5_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rev_rank <= 10 THEN r.group_revenue ELSE 0 END)/t.total_rev*100 AS top10_pct FROM ranked r, total t GROUP BY t.total_rev
evidence.methodology: Revenue aggregated at economic group level using COALESCE(parent_customer_id, customer_id); ranked by descending group revenue; cumulative Top-N percentages calculated in SQL

arr_bridge.new_logo_classification_note: New logo ARR classified as customers with zero prior ARR in all historical months before FY2025; historical_active CTE identifies all customers with any positive ARR before 2025-01-01; customers returning from zero are classified as reactivation; no reactivation events detected in FY2025

evidence.query: WITH monthly_arr AS (SELECT customer_id, snapshot_month, arr_usd, LAG(arr_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY snapshot_month) AS prev_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month), historical_active AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month < '2025-01-01' AND arr_usd > 0), movements AS (SELECT m.customer_id, m.snapshot_month, m.arr_usd, m.prev_arr, CASE WHEN m.prev_arr = 0 AND m.arr_usd > 0 AND h.customer_id IS NULL THEN 'new_logo' WHEN m.prev_arr = 0 AND m.arr_usd > 0 AND h.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'reactivation' WHEN m.prev_arr > 0 AND m.arr_usd > m.prev_arr THEN 'expansion' WHEN m.prev_arr > 0 AND m.arr_usd > 0 AND m.arr_usd < m.prev_arr THEN 'contraction' WHEN m.prev_arr > 0 AND m.arr_usd = 0 THEN 'churn' ELSE 'no_change' END AS movement_type, CASE WHEN m.prev_arr = 0 AND m.arr_usd > 0 AND h.customer_id IS NULL THEN m.arr_usd WHEN m.prev_arr = 0 AND m.arr_usd > 0 AND h.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN m.arr_usd WHEN m.prev_arr > 0 AND m.arr_usd > m.prev_arr THEN m.arr_usd - m.prev_arr WHEN m.prev_arr > 0 AND m.arr_usd > 0 AND m.arr_usd < m.prev_arr THEN m.prev_arr - m.arr_usd WHEN m.prev_arr > 0 AND m.arr_usd = 0 THEN m.prev_arr ELSE 0 END AS movement_amount FROM monthly_arr m LEFT JOIN historical_active h ON m.customer_id = h.customer_id WHERE m.snapshot_month > '2024-12-01' AND m.snapshot_month <= '2025-12-01' AND m.prev_arr IS NOT NULL) SELECT movement_type, COUNT(*) AS event_count, SUM(movement_amount) AS total_movement_arr FROM movements WHERE movement_type != 'no_change' GROUP BY movement_type ORDER BY movement_type
evidence.methodology: Monthly ARR movements classified using LAG window function; historical_active CTE used to distinguish new logos from reactivations; movements aggregated for months Jan-2025 through Dec-2025 (snapshot_month > 2024-12-01 and <= 2025-12-01)

logo_churn_details.methodology_note: Logo churn counts opening-cohort customers (positive ARR at 2024-12-01) that reached zero ARR in any month during Jan-2025 through Dec-2025; gross churn events during period

retention.methodology: Opening cohort: customers with positive ARR at snapshot_month = 2024-12-01 (180 customers). NRR: ending ARR at 2025-12-01 for cohort members (including expansion, contraction, churn) divided by opening ARR. GRR: ending ARR capped at opening ARR per customer (LEAST function) divided by opening ARR, excluding expansion benefit. Logo churn: cohort members with zero ARR in any FY2025 month. Reactivation treatment: no reactivation events detected in FY2025; if a churned cohort customer had reactivated, their closing ARR would be included in NRR but their churn event would still be counted in logo churn gross events.

evidence.nrr_query: WITH opening_cohort AS (SELECT customer_id, arr_usd AS opening_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = '2024-12-01' AND arr_usd > 0), closing_arr AS (SELECT customer_id, arr_usd AS closing_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = '2025-12-01') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oc.customer_id) AS starting_cohort_count, SUM(oc.opening_arr) AS starting_arr, SUM(COALESCE(ca.closing_arr, 0)) AS ending_arr_from_cohort, SUM(COALESCE(ca.closing_arr, 0)) / SUM(oc.opening_arr) * 100 AS nrr_pct FROM opening_cohort oc LEFT JOIN closing_arr ca ON oc.customer_id = ca.customer_id
evidence.grr_query: WITH opening_cohort AS (SELECT customer_id, arr_usd AS opening_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = '2024-12-01' AND arr_usd > 0), closing_arr AS (SELECT customer_id, arr_usd AS closing_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = '2025-12-01') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oc.customer_id) AS starting_cohort_count, SUM(oc.opening_arr) AS starting_arr, SUM(LEAST(COALESCE(ca.closing_arr, 0), oc.opening_arr)) AS retained_arr_excl_expansion, SUM(LEAST(COALESCE(ca.closing_arr, 0), oc.opening_arr)) / SUM(oc.opening_arr) * 100 AS grr_pct FROM opening_cohort oc LEFT JOIN closing_arr ca ON oc.customer_id = ca.customer_id
evidence.logo_churn_query: WITH opening_cohort AS (SELECT customer_id FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = '2024-12-01' AND arr_usd > 0), churned_during_fy2025 AS (SELECT DISTINCT fsm.customer_id FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month fsm JOIN opening_cohort oc ON fsm.customer_id = oc.customer_id WHERE fsm.snapshot_month > '2024-12-01' AND fsm.snapshot_month <= '2025-12-01' AND fsm.arr_usd = 0) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oc.customer_id) AS starting_logo_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS churned_logo_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT oc.customer_id) AS logo_churn_pct FROM opening_cohort oc LEFT JOIN churned_during_fy2025 c ON oc.customer_id = c.customer_id

recurring_revenue.methodology: Management classification: revenue_type = 'Recurring' applied to all FY2025 lines (100%). Independent restatement criteria: delivery_model = 'Subscription' AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL. All 2,880 FY2025 invoice lines satisfy both management tag and independent criteria simultaneously. No non-recurring or ambiguous lines detected. The independently restated recurring percentage equals the management-tagged percentage at 100%; no reclassification required. Note: all FY2025 revenue in the dataset is classified as Recurring/Subscription with valid service periods, which is consistent with the management claim of 94% but actually shows 100% in the structured data.
recurring_revenue.data_quality_note: All FY2025 invoice lines carry revenue_type='Recurring' and delivery_model='Subscription' with valid service periods. No one-time or professional services revenue lines are present in the FY2025 dataset. The management claim of 94% recurring cannot be independently contradicted from this data; the data shows 100% recurring by both management tag and independent criteria.

evidence.query: WITH fy2025_lines AS (SELECT fil.invoice_line_id, fil.revenue_type, dp.delivery_model, fil.service_period_start, fil.service_period_end, fil.line_amount_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_product dp ON fil.product_id = dp.product_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fil.service_period_start AS DATE)) = 2025) SELECT SUM(line_amount_usd) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN revenue_type = 'Recurring' THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS mgmt_tagged_recurring, SUM(CASE WHEN revenue_type = 'Recurring' THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(line_amount_usd) * 100 AS mgmt_tagged_recurring_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN delivery_model = 'Subscription' AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS independently_supported_recurring, SUM(CASE WHEN delivery_model = 'Subscription' AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(line_amount_usd) * 100 AS independently_supported_recurring_pct FROM fy2025_lines
evidence.methodology: Management tag: revenue_type = 'Recurring'. Independent criteria: delivery_model = 'Subscription' AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL. Both criteria applied independently and compared.

collections_quality.dso_methodology: Quarterly DSO = (AR balance at quarter-end) / (revenue for that quarter) x day count. AR balance reconstructed as: SUM(invoice_amount_usd for invoices issued on or before quarter-end) minus SUM(amount_paid_usd for payments received on or before quarter-end). Revenue denominator = SUM(line_amount_usd) for invoice lines with service_period_start within the quarter. Latest quarter is 2025-Q4 (92 days). This methodology uses period-specific AR reconstruction from invoice and payment history; historical payments after a given quarter-end are excluded from that quarter's AR calculation.

dso_historical_trend.trend_note: DSO has increased materially from 17.64 days in 2023-Q1 to 64.73 days in 2025-Q4, an increase of 47.09 days. The management claim of approximately 45 days stable DSO is not supported by the historical trend; DSO has been rising and the latest quarter exceeds 45 days.

collections_quality.weighted_collection_days_methodology: Weighted average of days_outstanding field from fact_collection, weighted by amount_paid_usd, for payments received in calendar year 2025 (payment_date IS NOT NULL AND amount_paid_usd > 0). This metric reflects average time-to-payment for settled invoices in 2025 and is NOT equivalent to period-end DSO. DSO measures outstanding receivables at a point in time; weighted collection days measures average settlement timing for paid invoices.
collections_quality.ar_aging_note: AR aging based on days since invoice_date as of 2025-12-31. Outstanding balance = invoice_amount_usd minus payments received on or before 2025-12-31. 63% of AR is within 60 days; 14% is in the 91-120 day bucket; no AR exceeds 120 days.

evidence.query: WITH fy2025_rev AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS customer_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fil.service_period_start AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY fi.customer_id), ranked AS (SELECT customer_id, customer_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY customer_revenue DESC) AS rev_rank FROM fy2025_rev), top10 AS (SELECT r.customer_id, r.rev_rank, dc.first_order_date FROM ranked r JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc ON r.customer_id = dc.customer_id WHERE r.rev_rank <= 10) SELECT COUNT(*) AS top10_count, AVG(DATEDIFF(DATE('2025-12-31'), CAST(first_order_date AS DATE)) / 365.25) AS avg_tenure_years FROM top10
evidence.methodology: Top 10 customers ranked by FY2025 revenue (service_period_start basis); tenure = DATEDIFF(2025-12-31, first_order_date) / 365.25; average computed in SQL

customer_health.population: Top 5 customers by FY2025 revenue (CUST-0001, CUST-0002, CUST-0003, CUST-0004, CUST-0007); dynamically selected from current-run revenue concentration

This customer accounts for 12.39% of FY2025 revenue and has $1,167,900.97 outstanding AR at 2025-Q4 end.

evidence.query: WITH fy2025_rev AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS customer_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fil.service_period_start AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY fi.customer_id), top5 AS (SELECT customer_id FROM (SELECT customer_id, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY customer_revenue DESC) AS rev_rank FROM fy2025_rev) r WHERE rev_rank <= 5) SELECT fst.customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CAST(fst.opened_date AS DATE)) AS ticket_quarter, COUNT(fst.ticket_id) AS total_tickets, SUM(CASE WHEN fst.severity IN ('S1','S2') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_sev_tickets, AVG(CAST(fst.csat_score AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_csat FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_support_ticket fst JOIN top5 t ON fst.customer_id = t.customer_id GROUP BY fst.customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CAST(fst.opened_date AS DATE)) ORDER BY fst.customer_id, ticket_quarter
evidence.methodology: Top 5 customers selected dynamically from current-run FY2025 revenue ranking. Quarterly ticket counts, S1/S2 high-severity counts, and average CSAT computed per customer per quarter. Severity mapping: S1=Critical, S2=High (high_severity); S3=Medium, S4=Low.

renewal_exposure.unsupported_reason: An authoritative deal close date and post-close diligence horizon were not supplied in the runtime inputs or Agent 1 test plan. Per the AUTHORITATIVE RENEWAL HORIZON RULE, renewal exposure cannot be calculated without an authoritative anchor date. The structured contract data in dim_contract contains expiration dates ranging from 2022-02-28 to 2029-12-31 with 181 active contracts and total ACV of $38,180,252.15, but these dates alone do not establish the diligence horizon. Renewal exposure is recorded as unsupported.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: No single customer accounts for more than 10% of revenue.
claim_comparisons.methodology_note: Independently calculated top-1 customer concentration at economic group level using service_period_start revenue basis. CUST-0001 (Northwind Retail Group) accounts for 27.60% of FY2025 revenue, materially exceeding the claimed 10% threshold.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Net revenue retention of 118% demonstrates best-in-class expansion.
claim_comparisons.methodology_note: NRR calculated using opening cohort of 180 customers with positive ARR at 2024-12-01 (opening snapshot). Ending ARR for cohort at 2025-12-01 = $36,261,693.31 vs opening ARR of $36,075,091.38. NRR = 100.52%. Management claimed 118.0%.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: 94% of revenue is recurring subscription revenue.
claim_comparisons.methodology_note: Independently restated recurring revenue using delivery_model='Subscription' AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL as independent criteria. All 2,880 FY2025 invoice lines satisfy both management tag and independent criteria. Independently restated recurring = 100.0%. The data shows higher recurring percentage than claimed; no non-recurring lines detected in FY2025 structured data. The calculated_value represents the independently restated metric (100.0%), not the management-tagged metric (also 100.0%).

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Logo churn has remained below 5% annually.
claim_comparisons.methodology_note: Logo churn = customers from opening cohort (positive ARR at 2024-12-01, n=180) that reached zero ARR in any month during FY2025. 17 customers churned = 9.44%. Management claimed below 5%.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Adjusted EBITDA of $12.4M represents a 32% margin.
claim_comparisons.methodology_note: EBITDA adjustment analysis is outside the Revenue Quality workstream scope. The mgmt_ebitda_adjustment table exists in the DDL but EBITDA calculation and adjustment challenge belong to the EBITDA/Earnings specialist agent. Revenue Quality agent does not calculate adjusted EBITDA.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Days sales outstanding is stable at approximately 45 days.
claim_comparisons.methodology_note: Latest quarter DSO (2025-Q4) = 64.73 days. Historical trend shows DSO has increased from 17.64 days (2023-Q1) to 64.73 days (2025-Q4), an increase of 47.09 days. DSO is not stable; it has been rising materially. Management claimed approximately 45 days stable.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Direct expansion into Europe is the primary growth vector, worth $6M ARR by FY2028.
claim_comparisons.methodology_note: FY2028 is a forward projection beyond available structured data (data covers through FY2025). Revenue Quality agent cannot project future ARR. Current EMEA/geographic ARR analysis would require geographic segmentation in dim_customer or fact_subscription_month which is not available in the current DDL. Test type is 'document' per Agent 1.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: All customer contracts are freely assignable on a change of control.
claim_comparisons.methodology_note: Change-of-control clause analysis requires contract document review. The dim_contract table does not contain a structured field for CoC restrictions. This is a document-type test per Agent 1 and belongs to the Contract Intelligence agent.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Revenue grew at a 14% CAGR over FY2023-FY2025.
claim_comparisons.methodology_note: CAGR calculated using service_period_start revenue basis: FY2023=$28,766,999.82, FY2025=$37,344,457.53, 2 periods. CAGR = POWER(37344457.53/28766999.82, 1/2) - 1 = 13.94%. Within tolerance of +/-0.5pp of management claim of 14.0%.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Top 10 customers have an average tenure of 6 years.
claim_comparisons.methodology_note: Average tenure for top 10 customers by FY2025 revenue = 5.60 years (measured from first_order_date to 2025-12-31). Management claimed 6.0 years. Difference of -0.40 years. Note: CUST-0006 (rank 6) has first_order_date of 2025-03-01 (0.84 years tenure), which materially reduces the average.

MFN clause analysis requires contract document review. The dim_contract table does not contain a structured MFN field. This is a document-type test per Agent 1 and belongs to the Contract Intelligence agent.

GRR calculated using opening cohort of 180 customers with positive ARR at 2024-12-01. Retained ARR excluding expansion (LEAST of closing ARR and opening ARR per customer) = $33,606,952.09. GRR = 93.16%. Management claimed 97.0%.

metric_evidence.metric: Revenue by period FY2023, FY2024, FY2025
metric_evidence.query: SELECT YEAR(CAST(fil.service_period_start AS DATE)) AS fiscal_year, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT fi.customer_id) AS customer_count, COUNT(fil.invoice_line_id) AS line_count FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id WHERE fil.service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(CAST(fil.service_period_start AS DATE)) IN (2023, 2024, 2025) GROUP BY YEAR(CAST(fil.service_period_start AS DATE)) ORDER BY fiscal_year
metric_evidence.methodology: Revenue aggregated at invoice line grain using service_period_start as period assignment date; joined to fact_invoice for customer_id; no double-counting of invoice header totals

metric_evidence.query: WITH annual_rev AS (SELECT YEAR(CAST(fil.service_period_start AS DATE)) AS fiscal_year, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS total_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fil.service_period_start AS DATE)) IN (2023, 2025) GROUP BY YEAR(CAST(fil.service_period_start AS DATE))), rev_2023 AS (SELECT total_revenue FROM annual_rev WHERE fiscal_year = 2023), rev_2025 AS (SELECT total_revenue FROM annual_rev WHERE fiscal_year = 2025) SELECT r23.total_revenue AS fy2023_revenue, r25.total_revenue AS fy2025_revenue, 2 AS num_periods, (POWER(r25.total_revenue / r23.total_revenue, 1.0/2.0) - 1) * 100 AS cagr_pct FROM rev_2023 r23, rev_2025 r25
metric_evidence.methodology: CAGR = (FY2025_revenue / FY2023_revenue)^(1/2) - 1; 2 periods between FY2023 and FY2025; service_period_start basis

metric_evidence.metric: Customer concentration FY2025 - Top 1, 3, 5, 10 at customer and economic group level
metric_evidence.query: WITH fy2025_rev AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, dc.parent_customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS customer_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc ON fi.customer_id = dc.customer_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fil.service_period_start AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY fi.customer_id, dc.parent_customer_id), group_rev AS (SELECT COALESCE(parent_customer_id, customer_id) AS economic_group_id, SUM(customer_revenue) AS group_revenue FROM fy2025_rev GROUP BY COALESCE(parent_customer_id, customer_id)), total AS (SELECT SUM(group_revenue) AS total_rev FROM group_rev), ranked AS (SELECT economic_group_id, group_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY group_revenue DESC) AS rev_rank FROM group_rev) SELECT t.total_rev, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rev_rank <= 1 THEN r.group_revenue ELSE 0 END)/t.total_rev*100 AS top1_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rev_rank <= 3 THEN r.group_revenue ELSE 0 END)/t.total_rev*100 AS top3_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rev_rank <= 5 THEN r.group_revenue ELSE 0 END)/t.total_rev*100 AS top5_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rev_rank <= 10 THEN r.group_revenue ELSE 0 END)/t.total_rev*100 AS top10_pct FROM ranked r, total t GROUP BY t.total_rev
metric_evidence.methodology: Economic group roll-up using COALESCE(parent_customer_id, customer_id); cumulative Top-N percentages calculated in SQL; reconciled to total revenue

metric_evidence.query: WITH monthly_arr AS (SELECT customer_id, snapshot_month, arr_usd, LAG(arr_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY snapshot_month) AS prev_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month), historical_active AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month < '2025-01-01' AND arr_usd > 0), movements AS (SELECT m.customer_id, m.snapshot_month, m.arr_usd, m.prev_arr, CASE WHEN m.prev_arr = 0 AND m.arr_usd > 0 AND h.customer_id IS NULL THEN 'new_logo' WHEN m.prev_arr = 0 AND m.arr_usd > 0 AND h.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'reactivation' WHEN m.prev_arr > 0 AND m.arr_usd > m.prev_arr THEN 'expansion' WHEN m.prev_arr > 0 AND m.arr_usd > 0 AND m.arr_usd < m.prev_arr THEN 'contraction' WHEN m.prev_arr > 0 AND m.arr_usd = 0 THEN 'churn' ELSE 'no_change' END AS movement_type, CASE WHEN m.prev_arr = 0 AND m.arr_usd > 0 AND h.customer_id IS NULL THEN m.arr_usd WHEN m.prev_arr = 0 AND m.arr_usd > 0 AND h.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN m.arr_usd WHEN m.prev_arr > 0 AND m.arr_usd > m.prev_arr THEN m.arr_usd - m.prev_arr WHEN m.prev_arr > 0 AND m.arr_usd > 0 AND m.arr_usd < m.prev_arr THEN m.prev_arr - m.arr_usd WHEN m.prev_arr > 0 AND m.arr_usd = 0 THEN m.prev_arr ELSE 0 END AS movement_amount FROM monthly_arr m LEFT JOIN historical_active h ON m.customer_id = h.customer_id WHERE m.snapshot_month > '2024-12-01' AND m.snapshot_month <= '2025-12-01' AND m.prev_arr IS NOT NULL) SELECT movement_type, COUNT(*) AS event_count, SUM(movement_amount) AS total_movement_arr FROM movements WHERE movement_type != 'no_change' GROUP BY movement_type
metric_evidence.methodology: Monthly ARR movements using LAG window function; historical_active CTE distinguishes new logos from reactivations using all pre-FY2025 history; movements aggregated for FY2025 period

metric_evidence.query: WITH opening_cohort AS (SELECT customer_id, arr_usd AS opening_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = '2024-12-01' AND arr_usd > 0), closing_arr AS (SELECT customer_id, arr_usd AS closing_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = '2025-12-01') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oc.customer_id) AS starting_cohort_count, SUM(oc.opening_arr) AS starting_arr, SUM(COALESCE(ca.closing_arr, 0)) AS ending_arr_from_cohort, SUM(COALESCE(ca.closing_arr, 0)) / SUM(oc.opening_arr) * 100 AS nrr_pct FROM opening_cohort oc LEFT JOIN closing_arr ca ON oc.customer_id = ca.customer_id
metric_evidence.methodology: Opening cohort: customers with positive ARR at 2024-12-01. Ending ARR includes expansion, contraction, churn for cohort members. NRR = ending cohort ARR / opening cohort ARR * 100.

metric_evidence.query: WITH opening_cohort AS (SELECT customer_id, arr_usd AS opening_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = '2024-12-01' AND arr_usd > 0), closing_arr AS (SELECT customer_id, arr_usd AS closing_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = '2025-12-01') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oc.customer_id) AS starting_cohort_count, SUM(oc.opening_arr) AS starting_arr, SUM(LEAST(COALESCE(ca.closing_arr, 0), oc.opening_arr)) AS retained_arr_excl_expansion, SUM(LEAST(COALESCE(ca.closing_arr, 0), oc.opening_arr)) / SUM(oc.opening_arr) * 100 AS grr_pct FROM opening_cohort oc LEFT JOIN closing_arr ca ON oc.customer_id = ca.customer_id
metric_evidence.methodology: GRR excludes expansion benefit; retained ARR = LEAST(closing_arr, opening_arr) per customer; GRR = retained ARR / opening ARR * 100

metric_evidence.query: WITH opening_cohort AS (SELECT customer_id FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = '2024-12-01' AND arr_usd > 0), churned_during_fy2025 AS (SELECT DISTINCT fsm.customer_id FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month fsm JOIN opening_cohort oc ON fsm.customer_id = oc.customer_id WHERE fsm.snapshot_month > '2024-12-01' AND fsm.snapshot_month <= '2025-12-01' AND fsm.arr_usd = 0) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oc.customer_id) AS starting_logo_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS churned_logo_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT oc.customer_id) AS logo_churn_pct FROM opening_cohort oc LEFT JOIN churned_during_fy2025 c ON oc.customer_id = c.customer_id

metric_evidence.query: WITH fy2025_lines AS (SELECT fil.invoice_line_id, fil.revenue_type, dp.delivery_model, fil.service_period_start, fil.service_period_end, fil.line_amount_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_product dp ON fil.product_id = dp.product_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fil.service_period_start AS DATE)) = 2025) SELECT SUM(line_amount_usd) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN revenue_type = 'Recurring' THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS mgmt_tagged_recurring, SUM(CASE WHEN revenue_type = 'Recurring' THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(line_amount_usd) * 100 AS mgmt_tagged_recurring_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN delivery_model = 'Subscription' AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS independently_supported_recurring, SUM(CASE WHEN delivery_model = 'Subscription' AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(line_amount_usd) * 100 AS independently_supported_recurring_pct FROM fy2025_lines
metric_evidence.methodology: Management tag: revenue_type='Recurring'. Independent criteria: delivery_model='Subscription' AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL. Both applied independently.

metric_evidence.query: WITH quarters AS (SELECT q.qtr, q.period_start, q.period_end, q.day_count FROM (VALUES ('2023-Q1','2023-01-01','2023-03-31',90),('2023-Q2','2023-04-01','2023-06-30',91),('2023-Q3','2023-07-01','2023-09-30',92),('2023-Q4','2023-10-01','2023-12-31',92),('2024-Q1','2024-01-01','2024-03-31',91),('2024-Q2','2024-04-01','2024-06-30',91),('2024-Q3','2024-07-01','2024-09-30',92),('2024-Q4','2024-10-01','2024-12-31',92),('2025-Q1','2025-01-01','2025-03-31',90),('2025-Q2','2025-04-01','2025-06-30',91),('2025-Q3','2025-07-01','2025-09-30',92),('2025-Q4','2025-10-01','2025-12-31',92)) AS q(qtr,period_start,period_end,day_count)), qtr_revenue AS (SELECT q.qtr, q.period_start, q.period_end, q.day_count, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS qtr_revenue FROM quarters q JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil ON CAST(fil.service_period_start AS DATE) >= CAST(q.period_start AS DATE) AND CAST(fil.service_period_start AS DATE) <= CAST(q.period_end AS DATE) JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id GROUP BY q.qtr, q.period_start, q.period_end, q.day_count), qtr_ar AS (SELECT q.qtr, SUM(fi.invoice_amount_usd) - COALESCE(SUM(fc.amount_paid_usd), 0) AS ar_balance FROM quarters q JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) <= CAST(q.period_end AS DATE) LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc ON fi.invoice_id = fc.invoice_id AND CAST(fc.payment_date AS DATE) <= CAST(q.period_end AS DATE) GROUP BY q.qtr) SELECT r.qtr, r.period_start, r.period_end, r.day_count, r.qtr_revenue, a.ar_balance, a.ar_balance / r.qtr_revenue * r.day_count AS dso_days FROM qtr_revenue r JOIN qtr_ar a ON r.qtr = a.qtr ORDER BY r.qtr
metric_evidence.methodology: DSO = AR_balance_at_quarter_end / quarter_revenue * day_count. AR reconstructed from invoice and payment history: invoices issued on or before quarter-end minus payments received on or before quarter-end. Revenue = invoice lines with service_period_start in quarter. Historical payments after quarter-end excluded from historical AR calculations.

metric_evidence.query: WITH qtr_end AS (SELECT '2025-10-01' AS period_start, '2025-12-31' AS period_end, 92 AS day_count), cust_rev AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS cust_qtr_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id CROSS JOIN qtr_end q WHERE CAST(fil.service_period_start AS DATE) >= CAST(q.period_start AS DATE) AND CAST(fil.service_period_start AS DATE) <= CAST(q.period_end AS DATE) GROUP BY fi.customer_id), cust_ar AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fi.invoice_amount_usd) - COALESCE(SUM(fc.amount_paid_usd), 0) AS cust_ar_balance FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi CROSS JOIN qtr_end q LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc ON fi.invoice_id = fc.invoice_id AND CAST(fc.payment_date AS DATE) <= CAST(q.period_end AS DATE) WHERE CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) <= CAST(q.period_end AS DATE) GROUP BY fi.customer_id), combined AS (SELECT cr.customer_id, dc.segment, cr.cust_qtr_revenue, ca.cust_ar_balance FROM cust_rev cr JOIN cust_ar ca ON cr.customer_id = ca.customer_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc ON cr.customer_id = dc.customer_id) SELECT segment, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count, SUM(cust_qtr_revenue) AS segment_revenue, SUM(cust_ar_balance) AS segment_ar, SUM(cust_ar_balance) / SUM(cust_qtr_revenue) * 92 AS segment_dso FROM combined GROUP BY segment ORDER BY segment_dso DESC

cust_qtr_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id CROSS JOIN qtr_end q WHERE CAST(fil.service_period_start AS DATE) >= CAST(q.period_start AS DATE) AND CAST(fil.service_period_start AS DATE) <= CAST(q.period_end AS DATE) GROUP BY fi.customer_id), cust_ar AS (SELECT metric_evidence.query: WITH ar_balance AS (SELECT fi.invoice_id, fi.customer_id, fi.invoice_date, fi.invoice_amount_usd, COALESCE(SUM(fc.amount_paid_usd), 0) AS total_paid, fi.invoice_amount_usd - COALESCE(SUM(fc.amount_paid_usd), 0) AS outstanding_balance, DATEDIFF(DATE('2025-12-31'), CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)) AS days_since_invoice FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc ON fi.invoice_id = fc.invoice_id AND CAST(fc.payment_date AS DATE) <= DATE('2025-12-31') WHERE CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) <= DATE('2025-12-31') GROUP BY fi.invoice_id, fi.customer_id, fi.invoice_date, fi.invoice_amount_usd HAVING fi.invoice_amount_usd - COALESCE(SUM(fc.amount_paid_usd), 0) > 0.01) SELECT SUM(outstanding_balance) AS total_outstanding_ar, COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_id) AS unpaid_invoice_count, SUM(CASE WHEN days_since_invoice <= 30 THEN outstanding_balance ELSE 0 END) AS ar_0_30, SUM(CASE WHEN days_since_invoice > 30 AND days_since_invoice <= 60 THEN outstanding_balance ELSE 0 END) AS ar_31_60, SUM(CASE WHEN days_since_invoice > 60 AND days_since_invoice <= 90 THEN outstanding_balance ELSE 0 END) AS ar_61_90, SUM(CASE WHEN days_since_invoice > 90 AND days_since_invoice <= 120 THEN outstanding_balance ELSE 0 END) AS ar_91_120, SUM(CASE WHEN days_since_invoice > 120 THEN outstanding_balance ELSE 0 END) AS ar_over_120 FROM ar_balance
metric_evidence.methodology: Outstanding AR = invoice_amount_usd minus payments received on or before 2025-12-31; aging buckets based on days since invoice_date; invoices with outstanding balance > $0.01 included

metric_evidence.query: WITH ar_balance AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fi.invoice_amount_usd) - COALESCE(SUM(fc.amount_paid_usd), 0) AS outstanding_balance FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc ON fi.invoice_id = fc.invoice_id AND CAST(fc.payment_date AS DATE) <= DATE('2025-12-31') WHERE CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) <= DATE('2025-12-31') GROUP BY fi.customer_id HAVING SUM(fi.invoice_amount_usd) - COALESCE(SUM(fc.amount_paid_usd), 0) > 0.01), total AS (SELECT SUM(outstanding_balance) AS total_ar FROM ar_balance), ranked AS (SELECT customer_id, outstanding_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY outstanding_balance DESC) AS ar_rank FROM ar_balance) SELECT t.total_ar, SUM(CASE WHEN r.ar_rank <= 1 THEN r.outstanding_balance ELSE 0 END)/t.total_ar*100 AS top1_ar_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.ar_rank <= 3 THEN r.outstanding_balance ELSE 0 END)/t.total_ar*100 AS top3_ar_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.ar_rank <= 5 THEN r.outstanding_balance ELSE 0 END)/t.total_ar*100 AS top5_ar_pct FROM ranked r, total t GROUP BY t.total_ar
metric_evidence.methodology: AR concentration ranked by outstanding balance at 2025-12-31; cumulative Top-N percentages calculated in SQL

metric_evidence.metric: Customer tenure - Top 10 by FY2025 revenue
metric_evidence.query: WITH fy2025_rev AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS customer_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fil.service_period_start AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY fi.customer_id), ranked AS (SELECT customer_id, customer_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY customer_revenue DESC) AS rev_rank FROM fy2025_rev), top10 AS (SELECT r.customer_id, r.rev_rank, dc.first_order_date FROM ranked r JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc ON r.customer_id = dc.customer_id WHERE r.rev_rank <= 10) SELECT COUNT(*) AS top10_count, AVG(DATEDIFF(DATE('2025-12-31'), CAST(first_order_date AS DATE)) / 365.25) AS avg_tenure_years, MIN(DATEDIFF(DATE('2025-12-31'), CAST(first_order_date AS DATE)) / 365.25) AS min_tenure_years, MAX(DATEDIFF(DATE('2025-12-31'), CAST(first_order_date AS DATE)) / 365.25) AS max_tenure_years FROM top10
metric_evidence.methodology: Top 10 customers by FY2025 revenue; tenure = DATEDIFF(2025-12-31, first_order_date) / 365.25; average computed in SQL

metric_evidence.metric: Customer health - quarterly support ticket trends for top 5 customers
metric_evidence.query: WITH fy2025_rev AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS customer_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fil.service_period_start AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY fi.customer_id), top5 AS (SELECT customer_id FROM (SELECT customer_id, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY customer_revenue DESC) AS rev_rank FROM fy2025_rev) r WHERE rev_rank <= 5) SELECT fst.customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CAST(fst.opened_date AS DATE)) AS ticket_quarter, COUNT(fst.ticket_id) AS total_tickets, SUM(CASE WHEN fst.severity IN ('S1','S2') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_sev_tickets, AVG(CAST(fst.csat_score AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_csat FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_support_ticket fst JOIN top5 t ON fst.customer_id = t.customer_id GROUP BY fst.customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CAST(fst.opened_date AS DATE)) ORDER BY fst.customer_id, ticket_quarter
metric_evidence.methodology: Top 5 customers dynamically selected from current-run FY2025 revenue ranking; quarterly ticket counts, S1/S2 high-severity counts, and average CSAT computed per customer per quarter

issues.description: Agent 1 test_plan.json references v_revenue_line and v_arr_month as logical table hints; these views do not exist in the current DDL. Substituted with fact_invoice_line+fact_invoice and fact_subscription_month respectively per DDL discovery.

fact_collection has 96 records with null payment_date. These represent unpaid/outstanding invoices. They are correctly excluded from payment-date-based AR reconstruction (payments received on or before quarter-end) and correctly contribute to outstanding AR balance.

All FY2025 invoice lines carry revenue_type='Recurring' and delivery_model='Subscription' with valid service periods. No non-recurring or professional services revenue lines are present in FY2025 data. The management claim of 94% recurring cannot be independently tested for the 6% non-recurring component as no such lines exist in the structured data.

CUST-0002 (Vantage Grocers, revenue rank 2, 12.39% of FY2025 revenue) shows sharp deterioration in support health from 2025-Q2 onwards: ticket volume increased from ~5-7/quarter to 25 in 2025-Q4; high-severity (S1/S2) tickets surged from 0-2/quarter to 15 in 2025-Q4; CSAT declined from 4.5 (2023-Q1) to 1.8 (2025-Q4). This customer also has $1,167,900.97 outstanding AR at 2025-Q4 end (DSO = 92 days). Downstream agents should connect this health deterioration with contract terms.

CUST-0001 (Northwind Retail Group) accounts for 27.60% of FY2025 revenue (management claimed no single customer > 10%) and has $2,966,640.91 outstanding AR at 2025-Q4 end, representing 47.57% of total AR. Customer-level DSO for CUST-0001 is 103.94 days in 2025-Q4.

CUST-0006 (Cascade Foods Holdings, customer-level rank 6) has first_order_date of 2025-03-01, indicating a very recent customer with 0.84 years tenure. This materially reduces the top-10 average tenure from what it would be without this customer.

Renewal exposure analysis is unsupported because no authoritative deal close date or post-close diligence horizon was provided in runtime inputs or Agent 1 test plan. dim_contract data is available (181 active contracts, ACV $38.18M, end dates through 2029-12-31) but cannot be used without an authoritative horizon anchor.
